batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c MC Henriques b AB Agarkar

balls.text: too full, made room to loft it between deep cover and long-off for a boundary, nice end but they would have wanted more
full on the off stump, makes room and bunts it wide of deep cover for a couple more, an appeal for a run out but he's just made it back in time
banged in short on middle, went for a mighty pull, swung away to go straight to the keeper, another dot ball
fuller on the off, chipped wide of cover for a quick single
good length on middle, goes for a heave over midwicket, fails to connect and the stumps are rattled.
yorker length outside off, tried to steer it past point, straight to the keeper with the bat hitting the ground
got his left foot out of the way, freed his arms and bunted it down the ground, just one more over to go
overpitched, sliced away to deep point for a single
yorker length outside off, makes room and digs it out between cover and point for a single
back of a length on the off, pushed wide of cover for a single
fullish outside off, driven firmly wide of sweeper cover for a couple more
good length outside off, drilled down to deep cover. Ravi Shastri says: "Nicely placed, (followed by) straight to the man in the deep".
misses out, back of a length outside off, goes for the cut, fails to connect as it spits away
atrocious delivery, slower one down the leg side, swept away to the fine-leg boundary
dropped, full and wide, came off the middle, creamed wide of extra cover where Sangwan flung himself to his right attempting to snap that one, but ended up palming it to long-off
slower one on middle, driven cleanly wide of long-on for two more, nicely handled
slower one bowled full outside off, makes room and drives it wide of deep cover
full on middle and leg, dug out wide of square leg for a couple more
good length outside leg and cutting back in, tries to clear midwicket, is hit on the pads and they steal a run
edged and four, short outside off, went for a ferocious pull, got a thick edge over the keeper and they get four, these two have recovered nicely after the maiden
short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg, mistimed it but manages a single
sweetly struck, full and wide, made room to slice it away over point for four more, went off the middle
short of a good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
Punished! In the slot on the off, got under it and smashed it way over long-on for a big one, struck cleanly and it sailed into the stands
pushed through the line wide of cover for a quick single
back of a length on the off, chopped short of cover, mistimed it
nicely done, full toss on middle, paddles it away wide of short fine for the first boundary in quite some time, they need a few more of those
slower ball bowled short outside off, cut away to deep point for a single
slower one bowled on a good length on middle, punched to mid-off for a quick single
drilled down the ground, but straight onto the stumps at the non-striker's end
fullish outside off, he's made too much room, tried to steer it wide of point, misses
short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg on the bounce
good length outside off, drilled down the ground to long-off
banged in short on middle, too high but not called a wide, one for the over
back of a length outside off, guided wide of third man for a couple
good length outside off, eased through the off side to deep cover for a single to bring up his fifty, he's been a significant contributor for Kolkata this season, well done
the googly bowled on a good length outside off, moved back in, got outside the line to cut, was hit on the pads, stifled appeal turned down, excellent over
excellent fielding, pushed away off the back foot wide of midwicket who hurls himself to his left to save the single
spun back in, the googly, picked it late, punched to point
short and wide, spins away, goes for the cut, misses
slightly short on the off, pushed away to cover
tossed up on the off, defended watchfully into the off side
sharp catch, and Hodge goes! Bowled on a length on middle, gets under it nicely and strikes it hard but straight to AB de Villiers at long-on who takes a good catch diving forward
swinging away, landed on a good length on middle, pushed down the ground to long-off
the best of the three, overpitched on leg stump, driven firmly off the front foot wide of mid-on, raced away, was beautifully timed
the runs are coming easily now, slower but too short, helps it on its way wide of short fine for four more
nicely done, full toss outside off, hangs his bat out to place it beautifully between point and short third, was too high, so given a no-ball
full on the off, driven straight to extra cover who's at the edge of the circle, just a single
they continue to struggle against Nehra, widish, made room to smack it through the covers, missed
bowled full on middle, played out to long-on for a single
works it away wide of midwicket for a single
short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg
back of a length on the off, bunts it into the off side for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, waits for it and cuts it away between short third and point for four more, they;re getting going now
this is the start, fullish on the off, chips it perfectly through the gap between long-off and deep cover, AB de Villiers runs over the ball which rolls over the ropes
excellent over, back of a length outside off, chased it hard, missed, and Nehra can walk back smiling
slower one bowled on a good length on leg stump, clipped away to deep square leg
fullish outside off, slashes hard, misses, good start from Nehra after the break
connects finally, but mistimed, this one came onto him a little quickly, pulled to deep square leg
slower, banged in short, Hodge is too early into the pull, misses, the frustration grows
short and wide, reaches for it to cut, misses, not called a wide
low full toss on the off stump, driven down the ground to long-off
short of a good length outside off, nudged wide of short third for a single
in the slot outside off, yorker length, played out to short cover, decent start
three in a row, a legcutter, spat away as he tried to cut and got some good bounce as well
slower one bowled short outside off, cut away wide of point for a single
slightly short on the off, nurdled short of square leg for a single
picked the slower one, banged in short, pulled away to deep square leg, the scoring rate has dipped
in the slot but misses, short of a good length outside off, tries to heave it over midwicket, misses, will be admonishing himself for missing out there
slower one bowled full on the off stump, bunts it down the ground to long-off
overpitched on the off, fails to latch onto it, dug out to extra cover
slightly short outside off, drags it down to deep square leg
good length on the off, driven straight down the ground to long-off
on middle and leg, dropped short of square leg for a quick single
gave it some air this time, on leg stump, tries to work it away, is hit on the pads
back of a length on leg stump, tickled wide of square leg
short of a length outside off, slapped down to long-off
googly bowled short on the off, punched back the bowler
tossed up on the off, dropped short of cover off the front foot
McCullum's entertaining stint ends!! Short on middle, he came down and pulled straight to Ashish Nehra at fine leg who took it inches inside the ropes
on middle and leg, turned away to deep square leg for one more
fullish on middle, gets forward and clips it wide of long-on for a single
has a massive swipe at it, good length outside off, misses, playing way too across the line
straight on leg stump, comes down and flicks it down to deep square leg
full outside off, drives it down the ground to long-off, the field is spread out now
thrown up on leg stump, down the track and bunts it down to long-on
back of a length on middle, punched towards cover
tossed up on middle, plays it along the ground this time, the slog-sweep again, much wider of the fielder in the deep, two more
goes for it, flighted on middle, slog-swept wide of deep midwicket for three more, was in the air for a while but in the gap
tight line, on and outside off, pushed towards cover
bowled shortish on middle and leg, paddled wide of short fine
spoils the over with a ferocious six over deep midwicket, short on middle and he charges down the track to punish that poor thing flat into the crowd
overpitched outside off, a touch too full, dug out towards cover off the front foot, kept him quiet so far, the pressure builds
short of a good length outside off, chopped down to point
short of a good length on middle, defended back to the bowler
slower one bowled short outside leg stump, tries to paddle it fine, misses, the batsman and bowler exchange stares, not given a wide there, probably made contact
leaving the right hander, moves away a touch, takes a couple of steps down to dab it to third man, misses
misses out this time, probably expected it to spin away but it held its line, tried to cut it past point, missed
similar shot, but this one spun away, played away to cover
spun in, a googly, chopped down short of cover, picked it really late
what a start, short and wide, stays his ground and chops it away behind point for four more, waited for it to spin away and dealt with it nicely
good stuff, flighted outside off, charges down the track and caresses it wide of extra cover and long-off for four
flat and full on the off stump, driven down to long-off for a single
sensible, keeps the strike, just dabs it wide of point for a single
massive, Bazzzzz, short on middle, gets forward and pulls it with contempt over deep square leg
misfield at point and they get three, just pushed to Warner off the back foot and he makes a mess of it bending forward to his left, never made contact
back of a length on middle, dropped short of cover for a quick single
Bazz is looking good here, fullish on the pads, drives it forcefully wide of mid-on for a boundary
that's disappeared, is he back? Full and wide, charged down the track while making room simultaneously to slice that over point for a big six
short of a good length on the off, defended off the back foot to cover
crashed through the off side, overpitched and he cashes in, drilling it past a diving cover for his first boundary
came back in a touch, spat in from a good length outside off, guided down to third man
good length on middle, pushes it back to the bowler
short down the leg side, tries to help it on its way, misses, and is gifted a wide
excellent fielding, short and wide, cut away fiercely towards point where Warner pulls off a superb save stretching to his right
banged in short on middle, pulled away behind square towards fine leg
down the leg side, there was a sound as it went to the keeper, probably clipped the pads but the replays are inconclusive
yorker length on the off, dug out wide of cover for a quick single
down the leg side, straying in line and concedes a run
McCullum is left frustrated, a touch fuller and he dances down the track to cream that into the off side, is nowhere near it and is made to look silly
probing him outside off again, holding its line this time, left alone to the keeper
chases it, good length outside off, tried to smash it over the covers but missed, almost done in by the angle again
beaten! Angling away from the right hander, hit a good length and it moved away to beat McCullum's unconvincing prod
bangs it in short outside off, guided down to third man for a single
that's it, all over, length ball on middle, makes room and chips it over mid-off for a boundary to seal it for Delhi

dropped, again, again, again!! Banged in short on leg stump, went with the pull from the front of his face, his eyes were off it, Henriques at deep square leg covered good ground to his left and spilled it reaching forward
he made room, the bowler chased him, dropped it short, tried to guide it to third man, the bounce got it to just evade the outside edge
short of a good length on middle, pulled down to deep midwicket
short of a length outside off, made room to slash it over point, missed
meaty!! That seals it more or less, length ball on middle, in the slot, he had a mighty swing, connected beautifully to clear deep midwicket
yorker length outside off, made room and dug it out towards cover, was sent back
two more, overpitched outside off, made room and drill it past a diving cover
bowled on a length on the off, driven a little wide of long-off and they come back for the second, good running by Dilshan
banged in short on the off stump, makes room, slashes hard, edges it over the keeper to the third-man boundary, too many of these today, too bad for Kolkata
full toss on middle, mistimes a pull just short of Hodge at deep midwicket, failed attempt to clear the ropes but manages a single
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, guided down to third man
short of a length on middle, pulled away wide of a diving midwicket for four more, the end is near now
there have been a few of these, full outside off, tried to smash it down the ground, a wild swing really, got a thick edge to beat third man
banged in short outside off, a touch too short perhaps, Dilshan tried to hook it behind square, missed
short of a length outside off, makes room to slash it away over point, misses, bounced more than he expected
full on middle, driven straight to midwicket where Ganguly has a shy at the stumps but Gambhir has made it back easily
fullish on middle, tried to paddle it fine, got the top edge and it landed well short of third man

dropped, Arindam Ghosh the culprit this time, another easy one goes down, good length on middle, paddles it wide of fine leg, an audacious shot that, ended up skying it and Ghosh running to his right appeared to get under it nicely for a moment but spilled it as soon as he made contact, tried to juggle around but to no avail
full toss outside off, makes room and slices it down to third man
yorker length outside off, went away to swing it into the leg side, brushed his pads on the way to the keeper
short on leg stump, went for the pull mistimed it wide of deep midwicket for a couple more
gets to his fifty, full and wide, made room and smashed it wide of a diving mid-off for a pressure-relieving boundary, nicely done
good length just outside leg, made way to loft it in the direction of long-on, missed
back of a length outside off, guided down to third man, Ian Howell was the umpire for the over

appeal for caught behind, got a big nick there, slower ball bowled short outside off, went for the cut, got a big edge through to the keeper, van Wyk went up immediately but the umpire got it all wrong, shaking his head
short of a good length outside off, cut away over point wide of third man for two more
full toss outside off, hangs his bat out to steer it wide of deep point for a couple more
lucky, good length outside off, makes room to smash it wide of deep cover, gets a thick outside edge that flies away from third man to beat Dinda to the boundary
tossed up on middle, comes down the track and heaves it towards deep midwicket, mistimed it but gets a single
dropped short of cover off the front foot and sets off for a quick single
short of a length outside off, cut away to deep point
pushed of the front foot towards cover and they set off for a tight single
gets on the back foot and plays it down to deep cover
flat and full on the off, comes down the track and bunts it over the bowler's head for a couple wide of long-on
good length outside off, charges down the track and tries to clear the in-field on the off side, misses
full and wide, makes room and slices it over point to beat third man to the boundary
full on middle and leg, tries to drive it hard through the off side, gets an inside edge just wide of leg stump towards fine leg
yorker length outside off, dug out towards cover
missed run out, pushed to McCullum at cover and Gambhir at the non-striker's end has already set off, McCullum back flips it towards the stumps and just misses, Gambhir was well short had that hit
tossed up on middle and leg, driven down to long-on
short of a length outside off, bunts it off the back foot to deep cover
arm ball on middle, chopped it to cover and set off, a shy at the non-striker's end, misses and they get an overthrow
fired in down the leg side, tries to clip it fine, misses, the keeper appeals for a catch but to prevent a wide, and does so with success
full toss on middle, comes down the track and swats it to wide long-on
flighted outside off, made room to slash it past point, misses
fired in down the leg side, held its line, tried to sweep, missed and so did van Wyk, and they concede five
flighted on the off, comes down track and chips it just short of long-off
tossed up on middle, driven down to long-on
flighted on the off, driven through the line to long-off
tossed up outside off, caresses it through to deep cover
fell just short, banged in short on middle, pulled away but just in front of deep midwicket
invited him out of the crease by tossing it up, played uppishly towards deep cover
arm ball on middle, punched wide of extra cover for a quick single
drifting into middle and leg, defended back to the bowler
quickish on middle, tucked away behind square for a single
flighted on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler
flatter on middle, pushed towards midwicket
four more, this was in the slot, much fuller, he made room, freed his arms and punished it wide of deep cover
driven on the up, good length on the off, struck firmly between deep cover and long-off, was not to the pitch but played it powerfully
back of a length on the off, dabbed down to third man
straying on the pads, looks to whip it fine, is hit high on the pads and they get a leg bye
bouncer and Dilshan backed away from it at the last moment, banged in on middle and came onto him a little too quickly
back of a length on the off, dabbed down to third man for a single, opened the face at the last moment
flighted on middle and leg, defended watchfully with bat close to pad
short of a length outside off, cut away straight to point
angling it into the pads, tries to clip it away, is struck on the pads
short on middle, pulled away powerfully but straight to deep midwicket
on middle, stopped on him, he was into the shot a little too early there, trying to work it away, got a leading edge just wide of McCullum at extra cover
short of a length on the off, bunts it to deep cover for a single
gone this time, came onto him quickly, short on middle, went for the pull, hit the high-end of the bat and lobbed up towards Henriques at midwicket who took it easily
short of a good length on the off, played away to midwicket
dropped by McCullum, was not to the pitch, just went through with it, skied it towards McCullum at cover who dropped a sitter while running back a couple of steps
short on leg stump, chipped from the crease towards deep midwicket, a short-arm chip
banged in short on middle, took a couple of steps forward to pull it square, missed and was struck in  the ribs
full and wide, driven towards deep cover
flighted outside off, creamed to extra cover but straight to him
pushed away off the front foot wide of midwicket for a single
tossed up, bowled short on the off, punched wide of cover, another fumble but this time they decide against a run, Warner dives full length to make it back
cut away hard towards point where a fumble allows them a single
dropped it short on middle, rocked back and pulled it away wide of mid-on for four more
hit firmly wide of point where a diving save prevents at least a couple
straying down the leg side, the keeper misses, wide and they get two
four more, uppish but safe, fullish on the off, made room and drove it wide of a diving extra cover, excellent start for Delhi
length ball on middle, got under it nicely, lofted it cleanly over mid-on, nicely struck
full on leg stump, driven firmly but straight to mid-off
back of a length outside off, guided down to third man for a single
short on middle, dabbed towards deep square leg for a single
short on the off, dropped it short of the keeper and scampered off, good response from Warner who makes it easily
good length on the off stump, tapped wide of point for a quick single
on middle and off, worked away off the front foot wide of deep square leg for a couple more
banged in short on the off, bowled quick at 139.5 kmph, mistimes a pull to midwicket
yorker length outside off, good comeback,. dug out wide of extra cover for a quick single
good length on the off stump, went for a blazing drive but mistimed it back to the bowler
That's disappeared, banged in short on the off, came down the track and pulled it away ferociously over deep square leg, picked the length early and dismissed it
he has to yell at himself now, slower one down the leg side, a hit-me ball, Gambhir glances it delicately well wide of Dinda for a boundary, Delhi are away
a fumble at fine leg at Dinda and Ishant yells at him, amid all the screaming and scolding, the Delhi batsmen have stolen two
misfield, absolutely atrocious fielding by Ganguly, driven wide of him at mid-off where he lethargically reaches for it, makes no contact and poor Saha has to chase it down to drag it back
back of a length on the off, pulled away over midwicket, not very well timed but had enough force on it to take it to the ropes, just a firm chip
straying on the pads, whips it away off his legs to the fine-leg boundary, held its line and got the treatment, a diving effort in the deep but ends up going through him
good length on middle and leg, chipped short of mid-on
sped off the bat, jumped on him but he played it down, rocked on the back foot and slashed it hard wide of point for a boundary
short and wide, held its line, went for the cut, missed
back of a length on the off, punched to mid-off for a quick single
short of a good length on the off, plays a short-arm pull to mid-on
good length on leg stump, tickles it wide of Sourav Ganguly at fine leg, where was he?
slightly short on the off, swatted short of midwicket, mistimed
full and wide, moving away, charged down the track, made room and tried to cream that through the off side, missed
held it back and touch and got it to move away, Gambhir shoulders arms to that one
short of a good length on the off, dropped short of the bowler and calls for a single, is sent back wisely
shaping away from the left hander, angling away, left alone
edged, landed on a good length on middle and swung away, tried to defend it from the crease, the movement induced the edge well wide of slip for a boundary
good length outside off and moving away, left alone
